_comment: TMDB cannot be searched by Finnish distributor title: it matches original, English and registered alternative titles only, and language=fi-FI does not widen the match (probed 2026-08-27). Key is enrich_tmdb.norm() of the title as the cinema publishes it. Value is either a TMDB movie id as a string, which skips the search entirely, or a replacement search string. run-enrich.log lists every title that found no id, which is what belongs here.

_comment_pressure: Myrskyn ikkuna is Pressure (2026), TMDB 1318413. Probed 2026-09-14: search/movie?query=Myrskyn ikkuna returns 0 results both with language=fi-FI and without, because TMDB holds no Finnish title for this film at all: no fi entry in /translations and no Finnish row in /alternative_titles, which lists only BR, US, SA, LV and PL. Search covers original, English and registered alternative titles, so no query spelling reaches it and this is this file's own documented case rather than a matching bug. Identity checked against the other 2026 Pressure, 1701077, a 5-minute short with 0 votes: 1318413 is 101 min against the 100 min all seventeen providers publish, has 394 votes, and its Latvian and Polish alternative titles both name the Normandy D-Day story. 93 showtimes across seventeen providers carried no tmdbId before this.
_comment_royal_opera: Kino Tapiola, 2026-09-16. The cinema publishes an opera relay as "The Royal Opera: Carmen" and TMDB registers the same event as "Royal Ballet & Opera 2026/27: Carmen", so the exact-title rule refused it: data/tmdb-titles.json holds the weak match 1702759 with x:false, which is the gate working, and the row shipped an initials tile with no synopsis. Id read off /movie/1702759, not typed from memory: the record is the 2026/27 season, the opera the cinema names, released 2026-11-10 in DE, and Tapiola relays it 2026-12-13. Only Carmen is aliased. Tosca is the reason the other three are not taken on trust: its weak match 1482356 is the 2025/26 season record, 3h30, released 2025-10-01, while Tapiola screens Tosca on 2027-06-06, so that id is the wrong season and would put a wrong poster on the row. Cosi fan tutte (1702775, DE 2027-02-23, relayed 2027-04-04) and Gotterdammerung (1702769, DE 2027-02-03, relayed 2027-02-28) are 2026/27 records whose dates do fit; they are left out because nobody asked for them, not because they failed.
_comment_practical_magic: 2026-09-16. The Finnish distributor title of the 2026 sequel is "Practical Magic: Lumotut sisaret", with no 2 in it, and TMDB holds that same string for the 1998 original, 6435. So the exact-title rule matched confidently onto the wrong film and 256 showtimes over 32 providers and 46 venue files carried 1998's poster, its 6.8 from 1853 votes and its trailer. The two chains that publish the title with a 2, Bio Savoy (PRACTICAL MAGIC 2) and Kino Akseli (Practical Magic 2: Lumotut sisaret), matched 1302904 all along, which is what pins the identity here rather than a judgement about which film a cinema meant. Ids read off the records: 1302904 is Practical Magic 2 (2026), 2h10, released 2026-09-11 in Finland; 6435 is Practical Magic (1998), 1h44, released 1999-02-19 in Finland. The 256 rows publish 129 or 130 minutes where they publish a runtime at all, and run 2026-09-15 to 2026-10-01. Kino Tar appends a strand to the title as a suffix, which run.py does not split, so that spelling needs its own key. Known cost: a repertory screening of the 1998 film published under the bare Finnish title would now take the sequel's id. None is in the data today, and the alternative is 256 wrong rows.
